findings: Supersedes the earlier Pincer-before-own-effect assertion: normal own effects return via6157->4469 before Pincer4728; deployment cancellation reaches Pincer without an own effect. Full top-level stack traversal checks both cases.

Each own-effect parameter and the subsequent Pincer parameter independently resolves the original targetCardID. GetCardFromID delegates to FetchCardFromCardID, which returns NoObject for nonpositive or missing IDs.
The headless core snapshots the ID before callbacks, resolves it for early weather, each own invocation and subsequent Pincer, and leaves the separately prepared currentTarget field unchanged.
Deployment multiplicity queries T23 only when the original integer ID equals0 (5782/5816/5830); a missing positive target or negative ID is not a non-targeted deployment.

WITHDRAWN by RULE-437 (2026-10-26): Inline selection continuation is held until the own effect returns and Pincer completes. Four additional empty/singleton cases observe that T43 callbacks run once, after both stages.

64 controlled identity cases cover both sides, deployment/nondeployment, Pincer/noPincer and eight target/map states. The own callback replaces the mapping again to verify Pincer uses its own lookup.20 multiplier cases exercise real B26 IR, zero/negative/missing/normal IDs and wait/nonwait modes. The old real T28 Pincer timing test is corrected.
limits: Top-level control flow assumes valid context objects and callbacks returning normally; conditions are explored nondeterministically, not a full interpreter/native proof.
Runtime checks verify saved script identity, byte length and branch operands; operand/property decoding and UObject pending-kill/GC semantics are not fully certified.
Map replacements, invalid IDs and controlled definitions/scripts are isolation probes, not proof real PvP cards necessarily create those states.
Four inline-continuation scenarios and the existing full selection suite pass; this is not an exhaustive scheduler/reentry proof. Native choice/network/action bundle ABI remain open.
TriggerDeployment is a separate path and was not changed. Full card effects, legal target validation, all Pincer subcallbacks and notification pipeline remain unaudited beyond prior bounded evidence.
Historical replay is not authority. No new game memory reads, writes or injection. Fully semantically verified cards remains0.
